detail: B02 schedule is frozen only on completed Sunday daily closes.
The Sunday decision is applied on the following Monday daily return.
All causally eligible symbols receive equal target weight.
Daily portfolio returns reuse unchanged target weights between Mondays, while turnover and fees are charged only when the weekly target schedule changes.
Turnover compares the new target with prior target weights rather than pre-trade weights drifted by realized asset returns.
The entry fee is deducted from equity_values[-1] before the equity series is built, so the reported initial capital can become 99,800 instead of 100,000.
pct_change(...).fillna(0.0) can turn a missing held-asset return into a zero return instead of a data-contract failure.
